Create a premium harmonious illustration with the entire original white wordmark large and centered on deep black/forest-green printed paper. Surround the intact logo with delicate symmetrical antique gold engraved scrollwork and fine radiant lines, consistent with the existing Heritage collection. The official white lettering must remain clean, unmistakable and legible. No new emblem, no plants, no people, no scenery. The only text is exactly 'Original Growing' in its original stacked calligraphy. LANDSCAPE 4:3 composition, complete logo within canvas, generous 10% margin around its outer swashes; gold ornaments secondary and outside letters. Every pixel fully opaque, no transparency, no alpha effects, no broad glow, no change to original logo lettering or proportions.
